currentContext.expansion: The only completed expansion project disclosed in the routed text is captive renewable power: during the year the Company commissioned a Solar Power plant of 9.74 MW capacity (DC) in the Spinning Unit II premises in order to reduce power cost, with the power generated directly consumed by Spinning Unit II; the plant generated 72.62 lakh units during the year. This sits alongside an existing captive wind fleet of 27 windmills totalling 23.40 MW — 4 windmills of 1250 KW each (5 MW) in Radhapuram Taluk, Tirunelveli District, and 23 windmills of 800 KW each (18.40 MW) in Dharapuram Taluk, Tirupur District and Palani Taluk, Dindigul District — whose entire output is captively consumed by the Spinning Units and the Weaving Unit, and which produced 408.60 lakh units of power against 322.14 lakh units in the prior year. The manufacturing footprint itself is unchanged: two spinning units near Dindigul (164016 spindles), weaving and home textiles units at Karanampettai near Palladam (156 looms), a processing unit at SIPCOT Perundurai (4200 tonnes of fabric per annum) and a knitting unit near Dindigul (4700 tonnes of knitted fabric per annum). No new manufacturing capacity addition, greenfield project, debottlenecking programme or dated commissioning timeline is announced in the routed text; the forward intent stated is qualitative — setting up offices in major Home Textiles centres to grow that segment, moving the mix toward value added products (Tencel, modal, polyester-cotton blends, Lycra knits) to improve spinning margins, and evaluating knitted-fabric exports. The Directors' Report states there are no material changes and commitments affecting the financial position of the Company subsequent to the end of the financial year. A Rights Issue is referenced only in passing (a footnote to Rights Issue expense of Rs.69.10 Lakhs); no use-of-proceeds or project linkage is disclosed in this bundle.
